modmenu.summaryTranslation.fancy_journal: A modern advancements journal on the J key.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fancy_jou: A modern, calm journal in place of the built-in advancements screen. Tabs per age with progress bars, search and filters, an Epilogue tab after the Ender Dragon, and a pin on every quest to track it: the tracked quest and its progress show in a small panel in the corner of the screen. Part of Fancy Vanilla. Hold Shift while opening it for the classic view. Language follows the game language (Options > Language).
